rounds.text: The business is suffering from severe momentum decay, evidenced by a 3-year share price growth of -9% and a 1-year drop of -16% [E24, E25]. Technical confirmation of this weakness appears as the price trades below both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E50], accompanied by a dismal relative-strength rating of 12 against the Nifty 500 [E51]. Fundamental growth is visibly decelerating, with compounded sales growth over the trailing twelve months plummeting to just 2% [E17] and quarterly operating margins contracting by 2 percentage points year-over-year to 15% in September 2026 [E31]. Compounding these concerns, the stock carries a staggering annualised volatility of 72.5% alongside a catastrophic historical peak-to-trough drawdown of -93.6% [E53, E54]. Conceded: the company maintains solid multi-year profit compounding, an absence of debt, and high returns on capital [E19, E37, E12].
